column4: Pixel-art sprite exactly in the style, pixel size, palette and lighting of the reference image, a 1990s Build-engine game sprite, flat pure magenta #FF00FF background, no text. The SAME old woman as in the reference with EXACTLY the same colours and clothes: the same grey hair in a bun, the same brown knitted cardigan, the same blue flowered dress, the same green rubber boots, the same wicker basket on her arm and the same small kitchen knife in her other hand. Full body, front view, feet at the bottom edge. She has turned in the night: she stands straightened up far too tall, a head and a half taller than any person, thin and stiff as a dead tree, her back cracked straight, her neck broken so her head hangs sideways on her shoulder, her arms far too long so the hand with the knife hangs down past her knee almost to the ground. Mushrooms grow out of her as if she had lain a year on the forest floor: pale brown caps with grey gills push out of both eye sockets and out of her open mouth, clusters of small caps sprout along her neck, her cheek and her shoulder, her skin is grey-green, cracked like bark and furred with white mould; the basket is heaped with mushrooms. Noisy, gritty, grainy like a scanned bad night flash photograph, muddy and desaturated, Loab-like nightmare: still the old woman from the reference, same colours, but terribly wrong. Body horror, morbid and repulsive, cursed nightmare fuel, not sexual. NOT cartoonish, NOT a witch costume, NOT a zombie costume, no glow, no smoke, no particles.
